units.source_text: 回到三条本邸之后，他还是眺望着月色，魂灵儿荡漾在天空中。

en.t: After returning to the Sanjo residence, he still gazed out at the moonlight, his soul drifting in the sky.

units.source_text: 众侍女看到这般模样，都在背后私议：“这样子多难看啊！

en.t: When the waiting women saw him in such a state, they all whispered behind his back, “How unsightly he looks!

units.source_text: 向来没有这种习气的呢。”

en.t: He never used to have such a habit.”

units.source_text: 夫人云居雁真心地发愁了。

en.t: His wife Kumoi no Kari was truly distressed.

units.source_text: 她想：“他的心全然飞驰到那边去了。

en.t: She thought, “His heart has flown completely over there.

units.source_text: 不知怎么一来，他把六条院中惯于妻妾和睦共处的诸夫人当作范例，

en.t: Somehow he takes as his model the ladies at Rokujo, who are used to wives and concubines living together in harmony,

units.source_text: 便把我看作不识情趣的厌物，真乃太没道理了。

en.t: and so he sees me as an unpleasant woman with no sense of refinement; it is truly unreasonable.

units.source_text: 如果我自昔就是多妻中的一人，

en.t: If I had been one of several wives from the beginning,

units.source_text: 那么外人也都看惯，我倒可以安然度日。

en.t: then other people would have been used to it, and I could have lived my days in peace.

units.source_text: 然而自他的父母兄弟以下，

en.t: But from his parents and brothers on down,

units.source_text: 人都称赞他是世间典型的诚实男子，

en.t: everyone has praised him as the very model of an honest man in this world,

units.source_text: 都说我是无忧无虑的幸福夫人。

en.t: and they have all said that I was a carefree and fortunate wife.

units.source_text: 岂知平安日子过到了现在，忽然发生了这件可耻之事。”

en.t: Who could have known that after peaceful days had lasted until now, this shameful thing would suddenly happen?”
She felt deeply unhappy in her heart.

units.source_text: 此时夜色已近破晓，两人不交一语，背向着背，各自唉声叹气，直到天明。

en.t: By then the night was nearing dawn, and the two of them lay back to back without exchanging a word, each sighing until daybreak.

units.source_text: 夕雾等不到朝雾散尽，照例急急忙忙地写信给落叶公主。

en.t: Yugiri could not even wait for the morning mist to clear, and as usual hurriedly wrote a letter to Princess Ochiba.

units.source_text: 云居雁心甚怨恨，然而并不像那天一样夺他的信。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari felt deep resentment, but she did not snatch his letter away as she had done that day.

units.source_text: 夕雾的信写得非常详细，其间暂时搁笔，吟诵诗句。

en.t: Yugiri wrote his letter in great detail, and partway through he set down his brush for a while and recited a poem.

units.source_text: 虽然吟声甚低，却被云居雁听到：

en.t: Although his reciting voice was very low, Kumoi no Kari heard it:
